title: WaterSound Crossings #425A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Discover the charm of a traditional beachside retreat at this cozy condo, perfectly sized for families seeking a relaxing and memorable vacation. With stunning views of the Gulf and an interior adorned with hardwood floors, soft colors, and classic wainscoting, every detail contributes to the serene atmosphere. The open-concept living area, featuring a dining table for six and additional breakfast bar seating, fosters communal dining and shared experiences. The kitchen, equipped with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, invites guests to prepare home-cooked meals, enhancing the home-away-from-home feel. The crown jewel of the indoor space, however, is the balcony. Offering a dining area for four and extra seating, it’s an idyllic setting for both sunrise breakfasts and sunset toasts. The condo boasts three beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with king-sized beds and private en suite bathrooms, ensuring comfort and privacy for all guests. The expansive master suite, encompassing one entire side of the condo, features a luxurious bed and a spa-like bathroom with a separate tub, shower, and double vanities. Outdoors, the proximity to WaterSound’s pristine beach, accessible via a scenic stroll over rolling dunes, promises days filled with sun and sand. Guests also enjoy access to community pools and the vibrant Hub on 30A, just a short walk or bike ride away, where evenings come alive with music, food, and entertainment. This traditional decor condo is more than just a place to stay—it’s a gateway to unforgettable beach memories and the joys of coastal living.
